section.title: Old tool results
section.subtitle: Swap older tool results for a placeholder: only the request body changes, the session log stays intact, and by default it runs once per round
field.enabled.label: Trim old tool results
field.enabled.help: When on, the body of older tool results is replaced with a one-line placeholder (the original text in the session log is untouched). When off, everything is sent as is.
field.refresh.label: When to trim
field.refresh.option.round: Once at the start of each round (default, best cache hits)
field.refresh.option.request: On every request (saves context, the prefix often goes cold)
field.refresh.help: One round = the dozens of steps the model takes after you send a message. Trimming once per round keeps the request prefix unchanged within the round, so the server-side prefix cache keeps hitting; trimming on every request rewrites whatever just slid out of the window and misses from there on.
field.keepRecent.label: Tool results kept as they are
field.keepRecent.help: These stay untouched and only older ones are trimmed. Larger values keep more original text for the model to look back at and save less context.
field.minSaveTokens.label: Minimum saving per result (tokens)
field.minSaveTokens.help: Trimming a short result saves little and loses evidence, so anything under this threshold stays. 0 means trim whenever it saves anything.
field.minFreePercent.label: Minimum total saving (%)
field.minFreePercent.help: How much of the whole prompt has to be trimmed in one round; below that nothing is trimmed. Cached tokens cost roughly a tenth and everything after a miss is re-read at full price, so trimming too little costs more than it saves. Default 25; 0 means trim whenever it saves anything.
save.badRefresh: When to trim must be round (once per round) or request (on every request).
